title: Implement Robust Error Handling Mechanism
description: This feature matters as it will provide a centralized error handling system, allowing for better error logging, and improved debugging capabilities, thus enhancing the overall stability of the yantraverse framework. It will handle and log errors in a standardized way, making it easier to identify and fix issues. This will also improve the developer experience by providing more informative error messages.
testCases: Test error handling for route not found
Test error handling for server errors
Test error handling for middleware errors
acceptance: The error handling mechanism should log errors with relevant details, provide informative error messages to the user, and not crash the server in case of an error. The logs should be easily readable and contain essential information for debugging purposes.
reason: Implementing a robust error handling mechanism is crucial for a production-ready framework like yantraverse, as it directly impacts the user experience, debugging efficiency, and overall framework reliability.
